newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI closes window for 12.59 percent 2004.
newsitem.headline: India RBI closes window for 12.59 percent 2004.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) stopped sales of a bond which opened for subscription earlier in the day, a central bank official said.
"We have closed the sale window," said an RBI official. "We are not accepting any further bids."
The RBI had put up the 12.59 percent 2004 stock for sale on tap earlier in the day.
Other details regarding the number of bids received and accepted were not yet available, the official added.
